Completed on branch `fix/qwen3-qk-norm-strided` at commit `3a3b9d2`.

Diagnosis: `unified.qk_norm` emitted `q_input_copy` and `k_input_copy` because Q/K are strided views and the recipe modeled RMSNorm as contiguous-only. Both leaves had empty semantic mappings and zero R6/R7 necessary work. The baseline scope across both cases was R0 `0.00047138` GPU-s and R5 `0.000088768495375` GPU-s, with R6/R7 both `1.792e-9` GPU-s. See the [baseline scoped report](logs/eval_before_run/reports/optimality_scoped_label_unified_qk_norm_qknormlocalworklet_local_1_gpu_qo_num_qo_head_e6287c8359c2.json) and the exact case ladders `pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder` and `pred.casev1.optimality-kernel-ladder`.

Fix: set `NORM_SUPPORTS_STRIDED` to `true` in [qwen3_dense_vllm_before.rs](simulator/src/arch/qwen3_dense_vllm_before.rs:16), preserving the Q/K RMSNorm shapes and head multipliers. Removed only the two empty-semantic locations from [the location map](model/work/location_maps/qwen3_dense_vllm_before_unified.json:6).

Evidence: after the cache-only rerun, qk-norm leaves are only `q_norm` and `k_norm` (`pred.casev0.operationv0.cost-tree`, `pred.casev1.operationv0.cost-tree`). R0 fell to `0.000272748` GPU-s and R5 to `0.0000443842525` GPU-s; R6/R7 remained exactly `1.792e-9` GPU-s. The [post-fix scoped report](logs/eval_before_run/reports/optimality_scoped_label_unified_qk_norm_qknormlocalworklet_local_1_gpu_qo_num_qo_head_e070601a37dd.json) confirms the unchanged necessary floor.

Verification: `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp/a9fd19a85147 uv run python -m launcher timing-predict eval-configs/before.json` completed successfully. `profile.db` retained its original timestamp and size; no GPU profiling occurred. Focused Rust tests passed: 1 `qwen3_dense_vllm_before` test and 3 `qk_norm_local` tests. `cargo fmt --all -- --check` could not run because `cargo-fmt` is not installed.

judge.reasoning: The report correctly identifies qk_norm's q_input_copy and k_input_copy as redundant materializations caused by strided Q/K views, matching the ground truth. However, setting NORM_SUPPORTS_STRIDED and editing the simulator location map does not implement the required stride-aware RMSNorm reads, so it does not have the same effect.
